# AGENTS.md - .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE

## Folder Purpose

GitHub issue-form templates for the public distribution repo: the structured
forms contributors see when opening an issue.

## Key Areas

- `bug_report.yml`: install/runtime bug report form.
- `feature_request.yml`: enhancement request form.
- `config.yml`: issue-chooser config (blank-issue toggle, contact links).

## Local Rules

- Keep forms valid GitHub issue-form YAML; a malformed file disables the form picker.
- Point contact links at real, current channels only — no fictional support URLs.
